task.description: Implement lib/letflow/design/iss0343-backfill-missing-schema-tolerance.md exactly. 1) Confirm empirically (not by assumption) the Postgrex.Error postgres.code atom produced for a query against a dropped schema/table -- done: verified against the test DB (MIX_TEST_PARTITION=99), CREATE SCHEMA/CREATE TABLE/DROP SCHEMA CASCADE/SELECT sequence raised %Postgrex.Error{postgres: %{code: :undefined_table, pg_code: "42P01"}}. 2) Add :tenant_schema_missing error variant to Letflow.EventStore.Registry's register_type/2 and get_type/2 @specs. 3) Add private rescue_missing_schema/1 helper wrapping a zero-arity closure in try/rescue matching only %Postgrex.Error{postgres: %{code: :undefined_table}}, re-raising anything else. 4) Wrap the three call sites (insert_with_monotonicity_check/2's current_max Repo.one/2 and Repo.insert/2, get_type/2's Repo.one/2) with this helper. 5) Add one new case clause in Backfill.run/1's Enum.reduce_while/3 body handling {:error, :tenant_schema_missing} as skipped with a Logger.warning/1 call conveying tenant_id, that the Registration row exists but the schema doesn't, and that this is expected under a concurrent teardown/offboarding race -- no @spec/arity change to run/1. 6) Run mix format, mix compile, and mix test (targeted: backfill_test.exs and registry tests) and quote real output.
acceptance_criteria: Postgrex error atom confirmed empirically before use, not assumed
rescue_missing_schema/1 private helper added, narrow match on %Postgrex.Error{postgres: %{code: :undefined_table}} only, re-raises everything else
all three named call sites wrapped with the helper
Backfill.run/1 gains exactly one new case clause for :tenant_schema_missing, treated as skipped, no @spec/arity change
mix format, mix compile, mix test run and real output quoted

result.summary:
Implemented the approved design exactly. Empirically confirmed (test DB, MIX_TEST_PARTITION=99, a CREATE SCHEMA/CREATE TABLE/DROP SCHEMA CASCADE/SELECT sequence run via mix run) that the atom Postgrex raises for a query against a dropped schema is %Postgrex.Error{postgres: %{code: :undefined_table, pg_code: "42P01", message: "relation ... does not exist"}} -- :undefined_table confirmed correct, not assumed. lib/letflow/event_store/registry.ex: added {:error, :tenant_schema_missing} to register_type/2 and get_type/2's @specs; added a new private rescue_missing_schema/1 helper (@spec (-> result) :: result | {:error, :tenant_schema_missing}) that try/rescues only %Postgrex.Error{postgres: %{code: :undefined_table}} and reraises (reraise e, __STACKTRACE__) anything else; wrapped all three named call sites with it -- insert_with_monotonicity_check/2's current_max query (extracted into a new private fetch_current_max/2 for with-clause composition) and its Repo.insert/2, plus get_type/2's Repo.one/2. lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill.ex: added one new case clause in Backfill.run/1's Enum.reduce_while/3 body matching {:error, :tenant_schema_missing}, logging via Logger.warning/1 (tenant_id, that the Registration row exists but the schema doesn't, and that this is expected under a concurrent teardown/offboarding race), incrementing counts.skipped, continuing the reduction ({:cont, ...}) -- no change to run/1's @spec/arity.

mix format lib/letflow/event_store/registry.ex lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill.ex: applied cleanly; mix format --check-formatted: exit 0. MIX_ENV=test MIX_TEST_PARTITION=99 mix compile --warnings-as-errors: 'Compiling 14 files (.ex)', no warnings, no errors. MIX_ENV=test MIX_TEST_PARTITION=99 mix test test/letflow/tenant_provisioning/backfill_test.exs test/letflow/event_store/registry_test.exs: 'Finished in 20.9 seconds (0.00s async, 20.9s sync) / Result: 32 passed' -- all existing BackfillTest and Registry tests (including register_type/2 AC2 duplicate-version and validate_payload/3 AC3 tests exercised via --trace) pass unchanged; no regressions introduced by the new case clause or the rescue wrapping.

Not touched: process_instance.ex (no gen_statem transition changed, no README state-diagram update needed), no migration added, test/support/tenant_fixture.ex untouched per design decision (§0/§4 explicitly reject that as the fix).
